title: Lifecore
description: LifeCore SMP is a high-stakes Heartcore experience where players gain hearts through kills or face a 24-hour ban upon death.
body:
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
##                          📌  LIFECORE SMP — OFFICIAL MANUAL  📌
**By ItzMASGaming**
## ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

Welcome to the ultimate high-stakes LifeSteal experience. LifeCore introduces a 
highly competitive environment where your health is your currency, deaths 
trigger automated server punishments, and a legendary weapon threatens player 
existence. 

Below is the complete manual detailing every single game mechanic, item recipe, 
and management command available.

### ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
### 🛡️  __THE 5-HOUR SAFETY SHIELD (NEW PLAYER PROTECTION)__
### ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
• Every single player receives an automated 5-Hour Safety Shield upon their very 
  first login to the server.
• The plugin actively displays a ticking countdown directly on your action bar 
  (above your item hotbar) showing exactly how much safety time is left.
• As long as this shield is active, you are completely immune to automated server 
  bans from environmental mishaps and player combat.

### ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
### 💀  __DEATH CONSEQUENCES & AUTOMATED SERVER BANS__
### ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
The moment a player's Safety Shield expires, deaths carry immediate consequences:

**🌍 1. Environmental Deaths (PvE):**
   • Dying to any natural hazard (lava, fall damage, suffocating, drowning, 
     void, or hostile mobs) triggers an automatic 24-Hour Ban.

**⚔️ 2. Combat Deaths (PvP):**
   • Dying to another player in normal combat triggers an automated 24-Hour Ban.
   • If you have more than the base 10 hearts, 1 max heart container is 
     permanently stripped from your health pool.
   • That heart instantly drops on the ground as a physical Nether Star item for 
     the killer to claim.

### ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
### 🔨  __EXHAUSTIVE CUSTOM ITEM CRAFTING RECIPES__
### ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

**🔸 1. Part of Heart (Crafting Ingredient)**
   • Visual Item: Standard Book
   • Crafting Grid Layout:
     [ Diamond ]      [ Iron Block ]    [ Diamond ]
     [ Iron Block ]   [ Golden Apple ]  [ Iron Block ]
     [ Diamond ]      [ Iron Block ]    [ Diamond ]

**❤️ 2. Extra Heart (Consumable Health Upgrade)**
   • Visual Item: Nether Star
   • Crafting Grid Layout: Must fill all 9 slots entirely with "Part of Heart" items.
   • Usage: Right-clicking this item consumes it and adds +1 permanent heart container.

**⚠️ 3. The Heart Breaker (Server Artifact Weapon)**
   • Visual Item: Custom Mace (Built-in Model Data: 8521235)
   • Built-in Enchants: Wind Burst X (10), Density V (5), Unbreaking CCLV (255)
   • Crafting Grid Layout:
     [ Diamond Block ] [ Heavy Core ]    [ Diamond Block ]
     [ Heavy Core ]    [ Bedrock ]       [ Heavy Core ]
     [ Diamond Block ] [ Heavy Core ]    [ Diamond Block ]
   
**🚨 THE WEAPON DETECTION TASK:**
• Every single second, the plugin scans all online players. If a player holds The 
  Heart Breaker in their main hand, their character model automatically glows with a 
  red outline, and a loud [⚠] warning tag is injected next to their name in the player list.
   
**💥 UNIQUE WEAPON DEATH MECHANICS:**
• First Strike: If a player is killed by an enemy wielding The Heart Breaker and 
  has over 5 hearts, their maximum health pool is instantly crushed down to 5 hearts, 
  followed by a standard 24-hour ban.
• Perma-Elimination: If the victim is killed while already at or below 5 hearts, 
  they are PERMANENTLY BANNED from the server. Your life force is completely shattered.

### ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
### 💻  __EXHAUSTIVE COMMAND LIST (PLAYERS & STAFF)
### ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

**👉 __Player Commands:__**
• `/withdrawheart`
  Reduces your current maximum health pool by 1 heart container and places a physical 
  "Extra Heart" item directly into your inventory. (Requires you to have more than 10 hearts).

• `/lifecore safety`
  Prints a clean layout showing whether global server bans, natural death bans, 
  and PvP bans are currently active, alongside any active automated countdowns.

• `/lifecore pvpsafety`
  An alternative shortcut command that targets and shows the exact shield status and 
  ban status specifically for active PvP combat settings.

**🛠️ __Staff & Admin Commands (Requires Permission):__**
• `/lifecore reload`
  Instantly refreshes configuration options and reloads item recipe shapes directly 
  from your config file without rebooting the whole server.

• `/lifecore giveheart`
  Spawns a physical, fully operational Extra Heart item straight into the admin's inventory.

• `/lifecore givemace`
  Spawns the legendary custom enchanted Heart Breaker weapon directly into the admin's hands.

• `/lifecore togglebans <on/off> [time]`
  Globally turns the entire server-wide ban mechanic on or off. Optional: Add a time limit 
  modifier (e.g., 2h, 45m) to automatically switch the rule back over when the timer expires.

• `/lifecore naturaldeath <on/off> [time]`
  Toggles whether environment, drowning, or monster deaths ban players from the server. 
  Supports optional time limits (e.g., 1d, 6h).

• `/lifecore banpvp <on/off> [time]`
  Toggles whether player versus player deaths trigger the automated bans. Supports optional 
  time limits (e.g., 12h, 30m).

• `/lifecore ban <player> <duration> [reason]`
  Advanced custom admin banning tool that allows staff to override settings using precise 
  time arguments (e.g., 1d, 12h, 30m) alongside a custom broadcast kick message.

• `/lifecore unban <player>`
  Instantly pardons an eliminated or timed-out player so they can rejoin the server map.

• `/lifecore timer <player> <add/remove> <time>`
  Allows staff members to manually add or subtract hours/minutes from a player's 
  initial 5-Hour Safety Shield to reward or punish them.
